caption: The drawing features a symmetrical design with two main sections composed of geometric and leaf-like shapes. The upper section contains two large, mirror-image motifs, each made up of four maroon shapes resembling stylized, jagged leaves or petals, outlined with visible stitches, joined around a central green cross with zigzag edges and decorated with green, spiked leaf shapes. Between these two mirrored motifs, an abstract pale cream space is left, matching the drawing’s background color. The lower section of the image displays a garland-like arrangement in green, with two large swags that hang between and are anchored on each side by maroon bows crafted from ribbon-like segments. The composition primarily utilizes green and maroon for the decorative elements, set against an off-white or light beige background, with all stitched edges emphasized in black.
title: Quilt
